title: Multiple Linear Regression II: Concept Matrix

fields.name: central_concept
fields.example: Joint inference, ANOVA, and categorical predictors

fields.name: diagnostic_lesson
fields.example: pooled association can conceal group patterns

data.model_form: A factor with c categories is represented with c-1 binary indicators when an intercept is present; the omitted level is the reference.
data.key_formula: A factor with c categories is represented with c-1 binary indicators when an intercept is present; the omitted level is the reference.

data.model_form: Changing the omitted category changes coefficient interpretations and individual t-ratios, but not fitted values or the overall model fit.

data.model_form: Joint restrictions are expressed as H0: Cβ=d, with C chosen for the scientific question.

data.model_form: Compare a reduced nested model with a full model: F=((Error SS)reduced-(Error SS)full)/(p s²full).

data.model_form: Testing MAR0 and MAR2 jointly gives F=3.235 with p=2 and 269 denominator degrees of freedom; the reported p-value is 0.0409.

data.model_form: The model yᵢⱼ=μⱼ+εᵢⱼ estimates each group mean by its sample average and partitions total variation into factor and error sums of squares.

data.model_form: A factor and covariate can have variable intercepts with a common slope, or both intercepts and slopes can vary by group.

data.model_form: The pooled plot suggests a negative association, but DRG-specific relationships show why an omitted factor can mislead; the variable-slope test is F=13.535.

data.model_form: Interactions permit effects such as slopes to differ by category; with two factors they can be interpreted as a combined factor.
data.key_formula: Interactions permit effects such as slopes to differ by category; with two factors they can be interpreted as a combined factor.

data.model_form: Continuous, transformed, and categorical predictors can enter linearly in coefficients; coefficient estimates can be nonunique under linear dependence.
data.key_formula: Continuous, transformed, and categorical predictors can enter linearly in coefficients; coefficient estimates can be nonunique under linear dependence.

data.model_form: Even when parameter estimates are not unique, least-squares fitted values, residuals, and error sums of squares are unique.
